hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Extend comma counting to an arbitrary interval [low, high].

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Express the range total as count(high) - count(low - 1).

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Use 64-bit integers and modular arithmetic if required.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Calculates comma prefixes in logarithmic steps.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Enumerating values between low and high is infeasible for 10^15.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies prefix subtraction with large integer thresholds.
